findings.description: render_finish applies the pending sub-threshold steps even when the bar was not run to completion, for example when the with-block exits early because of an exception, break, or Ctrl-C. The bar then reports progress that was not actually made.
findings.rationale: Trigger: update_min_steps=10, the user advances 3 steps and then leaves the with-block early. render_finish calls make_step(3), which advances pos and can set finished. If the pending steps reach length, the bar renders as 100% done for an aborted run.
